tast: Add fsutil package. We have many implementations of code to copy a file from one location to another, all of which are subtly broken (e.g. os.File.Close() isn't checked). This change adds a fsutil package with CopyFile and MoveFile functions. A proposal to add a ioutil.CopyFile method was rejected (https://golang.org/cl/1591), largely on the grounds of it being challenging to implement correct behavior on all platforms. I don't think that that argument applies here, and I also think that having well-tested canonical implementations will be better than having multiple untested ones like we do now. BUG=none TEST=added unit tests; also verified that tests using the new package still pass Change-Id: I1cbf944ab3d30a11063aea997b1d8467f6b1eb63 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1340556 Commit-Ready: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org> Tested-by: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org>

cros-disks: Recover from empty drivefs datadirs with incorrect owners. If cros-disks stops after the drivefs datadir is created, but before it's chowned, future attempts to mount with that datadir are doomed. crosvm_plugin: Remove underscores in variable name Remove the double underscore in front of `__has_extension` in crosvm.h. Double underscores in identifiers are reserved for the compiler's internal use and as it so happens, `__has_extension` is a macro that clang defines for code to determine whether the compiler supports a given feature. We shouldn't be using double underscores in any of the variable names in this header file but for now just fix the problematic one so that the code can actually compile under clang. BUG=b:80150167 TEST=Compile one of the test plugins with clang Change-Id: Ibb59e72c968a7f245bd6cc693da99f9263eedf33 Signed-off-by: Chirantan Ekbote <chirantan@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1341100 Reviewed-by: Zach Reizner <zachr@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Daniel Verkamp <dverkamp@chromium.org>
